connect_wallet: Connect a Solana wallet to play today's ranked board.
sign_in_desc: Sign a message to prove you own this wallet. It is not a transaction and moves no funds.
all_attempts_used: All attempts used today. A new board opens at 00:00 UTC.
score_computed: Score computed and recorded by the server.
lede: Same board and same pieces for everyone each UTC day. Your best of {attempts} tries counts.
mascot_alt: Rex, the BlockBite mascot, sizing up today's board
rule_attempts: Up to {attempts} attempts per wallet per UTC day. Your best one counts.
rule_server: The server deals the pieces and computes the score. Your browser never sees the next pieces early.
rule_verify: A fingerprint of the day's seed is published before the day starts. Afterwards the seed and every move are published, so anyone can re-check every score.
rule_daily: Daily prizes: {daily}% of the USDC that enters the prize vault each day goes to that day's top 10.
rule_monthly: Monthly prizes: the other {monthly}% goes to the month's top 10. Your monthly score is the sum of your {days} best days.
split_body: Split on-chain in the purchase: {vault}% prize vault · {team}% team · {referral}% referrer (no referrer: that {referral}% goes to the team).
vault_body: Each top 10 is paid on a fixed curve, 1st to 10th: {curve}% of that round's pool.
claim_note: Results are posted on-chain after each period. The team has 24 hours to block a result it finds fraudulent; after that, winners claim with their wallet. Unclaimed prizes return to the pool after 90 days.
sales_soon: Ticket sales are opening soon. The prize program goes live first.
cannot_sign: This wallet can't sign messages. Try Phantom or Solflare.
day_ended: This day has ended; the score stands.
offline: Could not reach the server. Your moves are kept. {msg}
hint_server: the server deals the next pieces after all three are placed
monthly_explain: There is no separate monthly board. You play the daily board; your monthly score is the sum of your {days} best daily scores this month.
monthly_connect: Connect a wallet to see your monthly score and rank.
monthly_offline: Could not load the monthly board. Try again later.
sales_open_now: Ticket sales are open: 1 USDC per ranked attempt.
